results.title: The Global Market for Space Materials 2026-2036 Report Now Available, Tracks the Shift to 60,000+ Satellites by 2036 as Launch Costs Fall Below $1,500/kg
results.description: The Global Market for Space Materials 2026–2036 report forecasts demand for spacecraft shielding, thermal management, propulsion, composites and photovoltaics, driven by reusable launch, mega-constellations, lunar missions and defence space. It assesses growth opportunities, supply-chain chokepoints, export controls and 136 leading companies.
